summary: FAIL on candidate c13a4f8e (a059b55). All thirteen of my earlier findings (F-DG0-201 to 213) were re-run: each reproduces on its original candidate and is fixed on this one, so all are CLOSED_VERIFIED. The seven required commands pass, and so do the A24/A25 rejection list, register integrity, agent-load evidence, the live guard probe and feasibility. New Medium mandatory finding F-DG0-220: the round-6 repair committed Python bytecode, which becomes part of the candidate. The shipped unit-test step rewrites it on any fresh checkout, so tools/gates/prefreeze.sh DG0 fails on the frozen candidate, and the candidate ID then changes to a different value on every run. New Low finding F-DG0-221 (agents.md omits run_meta.py and tool_authored); I would accept it as an observation.
